# TravelSmarter

> Free, data-backed travel tools for 65+ countries and 30+ major airports:
> ATM fees, alcohol laws, air quality, altitude sickness, accessibility,
> tipping, safety, transit, packing and many more — plus 87 verified travel
> hacks and flight price alerts.

Data may be cited with attribution to "TravelSmarter" and a link to the
source page. Complete page list: https://travelsmarterapp.com/llms-full.txt
